newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares edge higher ahead of SEBI meeting.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares edge higher ahead of SEBI meeting.

text.p: Delhi shares closed marginally higher in mixed trade amid expectations that the bourse regulator Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) might introduce steps to boost investor confidence, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index closed 1.22 points higher at 637.01.
"Expectations that the government might announce some steps to bring back investors into the capital market fuelled some speculative buying," said Sumit Gandhi of brokers Rare Financial Services.
Traders said start of the new settlement period also aided the upward trend.
SEBI has convened a board meeting to discuss the depressed capital market on Tuesday. The board is also expected to devise a policy framework on rights and bonus issues for mutual funds.
Larsen and Toubro gained 3.80 rupees to 201.30 on foreign fund buying, brokers said.
Cement maker ACC traded heavily throughout the session before closing 3.40 rupees higher at 963.40.
TISCO rose 0.20 rupee to 152.20 on selected buying by speculators.
Hindustan Lever rose 17 rupees to 785.0 on foreign buying.
Reliance Industries dropped 0.25 rupee to 183 on profit-taking.
